forward_return_definition: close of signal date -> close h sessions later on the panel's own session calendar; vs_spy = stock minus SPY; vs_ew = stock minus the equal-weight mean over names scored that date; last h sessions are null
mcap_note: mcap_current_not_pit empty (no universe_mcap.json in the snapshot)

not_point_in_time.universe: survivorship: today's universe screen (mcap >= $2B, 10d vol >= 500K, listed) applied backwards; the stored scores carry no history of who was in the universe on a given day
not_point_in_time.market_cap: mcap_current_not_pit is the CURRENT market cap; FMP gives no historical series here. dollar_vol_20d_pit (close x 20d avg volume) IS point-in-time
not_point_in_time.sector: current GICS ETF mapping from sector_map.json applied backwards
not_point_in_time.cross_sectional: any field ranked inside the universe (pipeline rank etc.) is ranked inside TODAY's universe
not_point_in_time.weekly_bars: see the `truncation` stage result for whether a forming weekly bar leaks into daily rows

composites_note: sc_*/pipe_rank are reference columns only; no list flags (longlist/elder/qs) are included
